summary: Keep Controller action results current without reloading the browser

guide.reason: Explain automatic result refresh, delayed Core outcomes and browser reconnect behavior.

api.reason: Browser read scheduling and presentation only: existing inventory/operations, pool membership, network/hardware and clustered-storage requests, authorization, Core commands and result schemas are unchanged.

roadmap.reason: Fix refresh behavior in existing capabilities; no milestone changes.

state.reason: Only transient browser observation state and read scheduling change; no durable setting or operation moves into Controller.

verification.method: Focused UI tests, TypeScript/build, standalone Chromium with simulated API responses, documentation and privacy checks; actual results and limits are recorded in the QA report.
